Based on the provided onboarding document, there is no mention of Honcho integration, peer generation, or passing user metadata through `/v1/chat/completions`. 

**Best Guess:** 
Hermes Agent handles memory via local files (`SOUL.md`, `USER.md`, `MEMORY.md`) or custom standalone memory plugins in `~/.hermes/plugins/`. If you are using a custom or third-party Honcho memory plugin, passing custom per-request user metadata through standard OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` endpoints typically requires explicit support for custom headers (or a custom plugin wrapper) to forward the user ID to the memory backend, which is not natively documented in the standard setup.
